scope.statement: Reconcile the original visible conversation, the multi-week saved history index, selected supporting records through 8 October, newer 9 October continuation evidence, current public source and the complete advertised capability metadata surface.
scope.completeness: The original 65-message transcript remains one directly recovered conversation. Broader account-history search failed; 429 saved text-file entries were enumerated, a complete RUN-0003 checkpoint dated 4 October was parsed, and 20 selected saved files were read (18 in full, two as bounded windows). The checkpoint indexes 82 problems, 118 attempts, 30 reusable patterns and 164 source records but explicitly has partial coverage; referenced sources are not all independently retrieved. Public repository records and the latest owner checkpoint supplement the history through 9 October. No complete account, Project or archive inventory or coverage percentage is claimed.
scope.publicationBoundary: Original generalised workflows and sanitised evidence summaries only. Private source, shared-conversation links, raw transcripts, credentials, secret custody details, host identifiers and restricted implementation references are excluded.
scope.invocationRule: A product mapping is a match to reusable procedure coverage, not evidence that its PROMPT.md or SKILL.md was loaded. Only supportingSkills records explicitly observed named platform-skill invocation.

evidenceSources.description: Canonical inventory and source provenance at the start of this catalogue review.
evidenceSources.limits: Shows that 11 prompt products and two skill products were already catalogued. Catalogue presence does not establish invocation in the recovered work.

evidenceSources.description: A complete extraction of 65 visible user and assistant messages supplied for continuity, reviewed in message order. Tool envelopes and hidden/internal content were excluded.
evidenceSources.limits: Direct operator output, assistant reports, inherited handover claims and proposed actions have different evidential weight. The shared link, transcript, attachments and operational identifiers are not published here.

evidenceSources.description: Read-only review of relevant merged changes, implementation, regressions and hosted CI for bounded provider reads, scheduled upgrades and dashboard rendering.
evidenceSources.limits: This is a sanitised review account, not independently inspectable public proof. Private code, repository links, revision identifiers, CI links and host details are withheld. Source and test evidence do not establish installation or current live behaviour.

evidenceSources.description: The visible transcript and a structured handover were persisted; the saved handover was read back. The named continuity and persistence skills were observed in the current session.
evidenceSources.limits: A saved handover supports recovery of context. It is not a guarantee that every future conversation will automatically retrieve the context.

evidenceSources.description: Canonical source and metadata were inspected and the skill-creator instructions were applied to author original reusable procedures for this repository.
evidenceSources.limits: Product mappings identify procedural coverage. They do not claim that a product's payload was loaded as a runtime skill in the earlier work.

evidenceSources.description: Merged Proof & State shared operating contract and generated governance evidence.
evidenceSources.limits: Establishes the shared state/evidence/authority vocabulary. Product-specific live outcomes remain separate.

evidenceSources.description: GitHub-owned Agent Shop deployment, crawler surface, Cloudflare outside-in acceptance, Search Console inspection and IndexNow verification observed during the current work.
evidenceSources.limits: Public source and current provider observations establish the exercised discovery workflow, not guaranteed future indexing or provider ingestion.

evidenceSources.description: A bounded Cloudflare deployment bridge reused existing repository secret custody, exposed no credential material, verified the public consequence and was removed after use.
evidenceSources.limits: The public skill generalises the lifecycle only. Secret values, private custody details and temporary workflow internals are not published.

evidenceSources.description: Tail Wagging agent subcontracting surface merged, passed repository-native acceptance, deployed through the Cloudflare production workflow, passed live GSC/on-page inspection and completed key-validated IndexNow notification.
evidenceSources.limits: The live public discovery surface and production deployment are observable. The structured job endpoint was validated by repository-native contract tests; a live job submission was intentionally not sent because it would create a real owner email/business request. PayPal remains unconfigured.

evidenceSources.description: Complete cloud and executor skill catalogue pagination and current tool-registry enumeration, plus separately declared controls; refreshed on 9 October 2026.
evidenceSources.limits: Establishes 111 distinct skill names across 195 surface entries (105 cloud, 90 executor), 868 advertised registry tools across 38 providers and 11 separate controls. Metadata does not prove connection, authority or execution. External instruction bodies are excluded.

evidenceSources.description: Dated launch, native scheduling, consent measurement and plugin activation work reviewed through the latest owner release record updated at 23:40 UTC on 8 October 2026 (9 October in the owner's local time).
evidenceSources.limits: The public record contains generalised summaries only. Owner-account connection and synthetic-test evidence are reported observations, not independent customer acceptance. Private screenshots, queue ledgers, account IDs, reviewer access and operational identifiers are withheld.

evidenceSources.description: Open One Click PR #8 repairs omitted/empty services producing numeric filler in a schema-valid handoff; reviewed head dd72e2dce1ca9e9dc4509d9069fefd4e32679d6e.
evidenceSources.limits: Public patch and reported regression checks support the candidate repair. The PR remains unmerged; this does not prove the public runtime contains the repair.

evidenceSources.description: OpsTruth PR #37 was normally merged at bf7a60f7ca37919071ef9f9c246ec18ec26b0d89 after a recorded eligible owner-led release exception; it includes bounded external-reader annotations, compatibility checks and telemetry privacy repairs.
evidenceSources.limits: Public release evidence establishes the recorded merge/deployment. The owner exception is not independent human review. A later local walkthrough and native submission have separate limitations; provider publication remains unproved.

evidenceSources.description: Merged OpsTruth PR #36 fixes raw SQL requests, response parsing, explicit legacy sampling weights and transport-versus-tool outcome reporting.
evidenceSources.limits: Establishes the helper repair and public merge state. Historical aggregate telemetry includes owner/test traffic and lacks user, cause and test markers; it does not establish installs, unique people or independent demand.

evidenceSources.description: Current OpenAI plugin submission and Cloudflare Analytics API guidance checked on 8 October 2026; provider-specific details are dated and must be refreshed.
evidenceSources.limits: Documentation establishes current contracts, not execution of a project's test cases, scanner clearance or production readiness. Analytics endpoint-specific references are also retained in the measurement skill.

evidenceSources.description: New main commits link the owned subcontracting skill to the independent Tail Wagging service guide and record exact-source Worker and outside-in acceptance on 9 October 2026.
evidenceSources.limits: The dated record establishes 21-product service discovery at that release. A separate later record proves the 25-product production release; deployment of this expanded 33-product catalogue remains separate. Intake, agreement, payment and execution retain independent authority.

evidenceSources.description: Exact-main production deployment and smoke passed for bf7a60f7ca37919071ef9f9c246ec18ec26b0d89. The latest owner checkpoint reports fresh native scans clearing all 21 tools and the privacy finding on the same draft.
evidenceSources.limits: This source describes the earlier release/rescan checkpoint. Its configured/not-submitted state was superseded by the later walkthrough and settled In review record. Provider approval, publication, conversation acceptance and production endpoint/signer acceptance remain separate.

evidenceSources.description: The merged release-readiness policy records the explicitly owner-directed solo-maintainer exception, its maintenance-only eligibility and required exact-head checks, protected merge, rollback and readback.
evidenceSources.limits: The exception adds no target-system writes, credential/signing authority, authentication scope, private storage, network destination or workflow/deployment authority. It does not impersonate independent review or grant autonomous policy-changing powers to the bot.

evidenceSources.description: Complete RUN-0003 checkpoint dated 4 October: 82 problems, 118 attempts, 30 reusable solutions, 39 decisions, 76 open problems and 164 source records. It separates evidence-qualified outcomes from inherited assistant claims.
evidenceSources.limits: The checkpoint is a partial institutional index, not all original chats. Six inherited assistant-only verified labels were requalified as unresolved. Native spreadsheet integrity checks are reported by the saved checkpoint; this extraction parsed the saved record and did not rewrite the sheets.

evidenceSources.description: Selected historical and current saved records were read for stale recovery, learning gates, operating semantics, runtime evidence, downstream outcomes, upstream due diligence and continuation.
evidenceSources.limits: 20 selected files were read, 18 completely and two in bounded windows. The 429-file figure is metadata enumeration only. One full transcript repeats the original 65-message source and is not a new independent occurrence. Raw transcripts and private locators are withheld.

evidenceSources.description: 9 August repair report records targeted effect-free stale-parent/orphan-child recovery, canonical attempt-based occupancy and unchanged unrelated state.
evidenceSources.limits: Historical reported tests and natural-cycle acceptance are not a fresh host-health result; unrelated process leaks were not independently established as the cause.

evidenceSources.description: 9 August workflow-monitor report records exact ingress handling followed by live equivalence coalescing under the durable graph admission path.
evidenceSources.limits: Coalescing applies only to equivalent currently owned unexpired attempts. Historical regression counts are not tests run by this extraction.

evidenceSources.description: Learning admission, verified effect-equivalence and the later comparable-measurement gate were reviewed with 14 September publication/readback and deferral observations.
evidenceSources.limits: Verified publication, measurement maturity and challenger spacing are distinct. One provider had verified publication without a performance snapshot; another had no predecessor publication. These are dated observations, not current campaign status.

evidenceSources.description: Current canonical warning semantics, versioned console field dictionary, generated reference/examples and snapshot projection implementation were checked against saved acceptance records.
evidenceSources.limits: Console fixture performance does not establish provider throughput. Documented commands do not grant execution authority.

evidenceSources.description: Current late-outcome recovery validates privacy-bounded source/event identity, durable holding, cursor safety, conflict-aware ingestion and fair bounded replay against verified publication evidence.
evidenceSources.limits: Implementation and recorded tests do not prove every production crash path or customer outcome; identity correlation is descriptive, not causal.

evidenceSources.description: 8 October audit identified independent fulfilment/evidence failures and unverified caller labels. Current public source contains duplicate-payment outcome reconciliation and signed attribution handling.
evidenceSources.limits: A payment signature does not authenticate campaign labels. Full contact-outbox durability and production fault-injection acceptance are not established by this review.

evidenceSources.description: 8 October work records the failed arbitrary-frame workaround and the matching server/first-client theme-state repair; current ThemeProvider source was read.
evidenceSources.limits: Browser results are reported observations. The verified document root boundary is application-specific; other providers and downstream business acceptance need their own checks.

evidenceSources.description: Public account-deletion evidence separates real authenticated account cleanup/session rejection from a synthetic production-storage admitted-write race with registry and credential fences.
evidenceSources.limits: Indexed service cleanup is not external account/key revocation or an independent verifier verdict. Fixture acceptance does not replace each customer's deletion result.

evidenceSources.description: Latest project state records the merged/deployed App admission repair: customer permission is identity-bound and separate from installation capability; the current customer role remains read.
evidenceSources.limits: 174 Worker tests and 11 admission cases are recorded project results, not tests run by this extraction. No fresh objective/model run or completed customer journey is established.

evidenceSources.description: Latest 9 October checkpoint supersedes missing-recording and not-submitted blockers: a 173-second labelled exact-release local walkthrough was hosted/read back, the same package received only recording metadata, and settled native detail shows In review.
evidenceSources.limits: Five positive server calls and three boundary assertions used a local runtime/test signer and real public GET reads. They are not ChatGPT conversational routing/refusal, production endpoint or production signer acceptance. The evidence graph remains partial and release readiness unproven; publication is still not established.

evidenceSources.description: The separately completed 25-product release records exact-main CI, Worker deployment and outside-in acceptance across all product routes, five machine surfaces and ten crawler identities.
evidenceSources.limits: The record proves the 25-product release, not deployment of this expanded 33-product catalogue. Sitemap acceptance is not indexing.

procedures.name: Recover an earlier conversation into durable working context
procedures.trigger: Continue work from a shared conversation without losing decisions, evidence or open acceptance checks.

evidence.summary: Recovered prior state, separated inherited claims from current observations and retained unresolved next steps.
Extracted all visible messages, saved a clean transcript and structured handover, and read back the handover.

limits: Durable context is a recovery record; it does not grant new operational authority or prove old completion claims.
Automatic cross-conversation retrieval is not established.

procedures.name: Separate host routing, transport, authentication and document failures
procedures.trigger: A provider read fails differently between environments or after a network change.

evidence.summary: Compared host and guest connectivity, address-family behaviour, endpoint reachability and the later authenticated reader result.
Reviewed bounded token-refresh transport retry and sanitised exception classification.

limits: Endpoint reachability and an expected HTTP rejection do not prove authentication or a complete provider read.
The WSL configuration change has historical operator evidence, not an independently reproduced network root cause or a universal fix.

procedures.name: Back up host configuration and verify effective activation
procedures.trigger: A host or virtual-machine setting has been edited but the running environment may still use the previous setting.

evidence.summary: Preserved resource settings and a backup, compared configuration modification time with the VM boot time, then checked the effective network mode after restart.

limits: A saved configuration file is not evidence of activation.
The reusable procedure requires a scope-aware drain and restart plan; the historical outcome does not justify automatic host-wide changes.

procedures.name: Pause wake-ups, drain work and restore scheduling
procedures.trigger: A scheduled runtime needs maintenance while timers, workers or queued jobs may still be active.

evidence.summary: Recorded bounded maintenance instructions and observed timer state around an environment restart.
Reviewed timer-state preservation, worker draining, stale-review rejection, cancellation handling and restoration paths.

limits: Source regressions do not establish real systemd operation or completion of the later release switch.
Queueing collection or refill work is not proof that the work completed.

procedures.name: Run bounded host diagnostics and recover from malformed shell input
procedures.trigger: Diagnostic commands hang, a multiline command is incomplete or terminal output risks mixing secrets with evidence.

evidence.summary: Replaced malformed shell input with bounded probes and kept saved-stage evidence distinct from process output.

limits: Use explicit time and output bounds and inspect exit status; avoid dumping credentials, arbitrary environment variables or provider response bodies.
A shell process returning zero does not override a failed structured result.

procedures.name: Reconcile dashboard state with the underlying observation
procedures.trigger: Cards, counters, freshness labels or readiness indicators disagree with recorded collector or provider results.

evidence.summary: Compared preview results and collector stages with reported dashboard views, separating supply, readiness, rendering and freshness.
Verified that a render failure could leave old values and prevent freshness initialisation.

limits: Referenced video attachments were not independently replayed during this catalogue review.
Synthetic render success does not prove live provider data, host deployment or business readiness.

procedures.name: Localise collector failure and shared deadline starvation
procedures.trigger: A multi-stage collection run contains mixed fast failures, long timeouts or missing diagnostics.

evidence.summary: Compared stage timing, exit status and shared budget consumption to identify distinct failure layers and missing detail.

limits: The shared deadline diagnosis was recorded; a general budget correction was not demonstrated.
Separate source and reply failures remained unresolved in the reviewed evidence.

procedures.name: Read semantic preview results and eligibility correctly
procedures.trigger: A dry-run or read-only provider preview finishes but reports unavailable data, no eligible work or no applied changes.

evidence.summary: Observed an unsuccessful authenticated reader result despite a successful wrapper exit, followed by a successful compact-response preview without applying imports or remote document updates; local credential-refresh or diagnostic writes are a separate concern.

limits: A successful read can legitimately yield no eligible work.
Preview success does not establish a saved scheduled observation, publication, final installation or ongoing service health.

procedures.name: Trace a swallowed reader failure without exposing provider data
procedures.trigger: A generic exception obscures which bounded read or parser stage rejected a response.

evidence.summary: Used a narrow exception trace to locate the failing bounded-read path without treating arbitrary exception text as safe output.
Reviewed projection of bounded exception classes and transport-only retry classification.

limits: Classify known stages and exception classes; document bodies, tokens, raw URLs with credentials and arbitrary exception payloads remain excluded.
Transport retries do not authorise repeating side-effecting writes.

procedures.name: Reduce document formatting overhead while preserving read contracts
procedures.trigger: A complete Google Docs JSON response exceeds a bounded reader's response limit.

evidence.summary: A compact-JSON read-only preview succeeded after an earlier bounded response rejection.
Verified compact responses under the unchanged byte ceiling, nested document traversal, suggestion handling, revision/position retention and rejection of concurrent changes.

limits: Compact JSON is an optimisation, not a guarantee that every document fits.
Do not silently truncate, omit document tabs or raise the configured response limit.
Passing code and regression evidence do not prove the final revision was installed on the owner's host.

procedures.name: Repair shared DOM ownership and verify successive dashboard updates
procedures.trigger: Mounting a new view removes elements that an existing streaming renderer still updates.

evidence.summary: Verified preservation of live render targets, complete initial rendering, successive streamed updates, focus/reading state, CSP-compatible locator waits and a passing browser run over the integrated source tree.

limits: These assertions cover the exercised synthetic browser scenarios.
Live provider correctness, current host deployment, reconnect behaviour and every possible stale-state condition are not established by those scenarios.

procedures.name: Deliver a narrow repository change with truthful validation
procedures.trigger: A diagnosed defect needs a reviewable patch, regression coverage and an exact-revision handoff.

evidence.summary: Reported focused fixes, regression work and repository-native validation.
Independently checked merged changes and successful main/browser workflows, including equality between the tested browser merge tree and final integrated tree.
Reused this workflow's evidence and public-learning boundaries when selecting original skill products instead of duplicating existing products or exporting private source.

limits: Local checks, hosted CI, merge state, installed artifacts and live behaviour are separate evidence classes.
The exact full-suite test count reported in the earlier conversation was not independently extracted and is not a catalogue claim.

procedures.name: Hand off an exact runtime revision with separate live acceptance
procedures.trigger: Code is merged but installation, the running process and later scheduled results still need verification.

evidence.summary: Specified an exact target revision, bounded drain, guarded apply, timer restoration and runtime/console acceptance conditions.
Verified single guarded apply, fresh state review, runtime identity checks and deferred heavyweight diagnostics after lightweight readiness.

limits: The final host switch and live acceptance were not confirmed in the reviewed record.
A started or queued follow-up observation remains pending until its result is read back.
Do not rerun an ambiguous switch merely because a later expensive diagnostic timed out.

procedures.name: Keep execution, consequence, readback and outcome as separate evidence-backed states
procedures.trigger: A workflow is at risk of treating a lower-layer success as completion.

evidence.summary: The shared operating contract merged with generated docs and CI-enforced state/evidence distinctions.
Deployment, outside-in acceptance, sitemap submission, URL discovery and indexing were observed as separate states.

limits: The vocabulary does not replace product-specific state machines.
A demonstrated state model does not prove every consumer has adopted it.

procedures.name: Build truthful machine-discovery surfaces from one canonical public source
procedures.trigger: A public capability site needs to be discoverable by search crawlers, LLM crawlers and direct agents.

evidence.summary: Implemented canonical HTML, robots, sitemap, JSON, agents/LLM guidance and raw metadata, then verified the production origin and live SEO surface.
The reusable machine-discovery truthfulness and acceptance rules were promoted into parent governance.

limits: Crawler permission does not guarantee provider indexing, retrieval or model ingestion.
Private payloads remain outside the public discovery surface.

procedures.name: Verify a deployed agent/search surface from the unauthenticated public boundary
procedures.trigger: A build or deployment is green but public routing, canonical origin or crawler behaviour still needs proof.

evidence.summary: Caught and repaired a real root-routing defect after deploy, then verified all canonical routes, machine surfaces, crawler user agents, sitemap and provider discovery state.
The separately deployed 25-product release passed outside-in route, metadata, machine-surface and crawler checks.

limits: Representative user-agent checks do not cover every network edge.
HTTP reachability and sitemap acceptance remain distinct from indexing.

procedures.name: Use existing credential custody for one bounded operation and remove the bridge
procedures.trigger: A target repository lacks direct provider credentials but another already-authorised authority can perform one bounded action.

evidence.summary: Observed stale custody in one repository, reused current custody from another without exposing credentials, verified the public consequence, and retired the temporary bridge.

limits: A temporary bridge is not a recommendation for permanent cross-repository credential sharing.
Credential rotation or creation remains a separate authority decision.

procedures.name: Publish an agent-discoverable subcontracting surface with bounded intake and authoritative payment terms
procedures.trigger: A service business wants agents to delegate website/repository work instead of attempting it themselves.

evidence.summary: The public Tail Wagging implementation exposes /agents/, /agents.txt and /agent-services.json, enforces a bounded structured job request, keeps published Stripe packages server-authoritative, leaves custom work quote-first, separates job receipt/payment/work states, passed exact-head acceptance, deployed to Cloudflare, and reached a zero-issue live audit with key-validated IndexNow submission.

limits: A real production job POST was not sent because that would create a consequential business request/email; the endpoint contract is established by repository-native tests and deployment of the tested Worker.
Published Stripe package checkout and custom quote-first work are distinct; arbitrary custom pricing is not accepted.
PayPal is explicitly not established as a configured payment provider.
Discovery and job receipt do not grant repository or production mutation authority.

procedures.name: Inventory advertised skills and tools without upgrading them into runtime claims
procedures.trigger: New capabilities are available or a prior handover treats listing metadata as operational readiness.

evidence.summary: Enumerated every skill catalogue page, retained cloud/executor surfaces, deduplicated names and enumerated the current registry separately from orchestration controls.

limits: A metadata snapshot is scoped to one session and capture date.
Advertised tools and skills are external dependencies; connection, permission and execution remain separate.

procedures.name: Advance an initial MCP draft through ownership and discovery while preserving later gates
procedures.trigger: A skills-only publication is mistaken for a working MCP integration or an activation draft needs recovery.

evidence.summary: Recovered a separate initial OpsTruth draft, corrected its package and listing metadata, verified the canonical domain and discovered 21 tools; the draft remained unpublished.
Checked the current initial-MCP submission route and required executed review material.
The corrected runtime was merged/deployed, production smoke passed and fresh provider scans cleared the tool and privacy findings while the draft stayed unpublished.
A labelled local walkthrough and settled In review state supersede the missing recording and not-submitted checkpoints.

limits: Provider discovery and scanner clearance do not establish current conversation exposure or live conversational review acceptance.
The recording and native submission are reported completed; approval, publication, production endpoint/signer and clean-account acceptance remain separate.
No new Agent Shop MCP server is introduced.

procedures.name: Repair external-reader annotations without weakening historical compatibility checks
procedures.trigger: Automated discovery flags external read-only tools as closed-domain.

evidence.summary: Changed only the ten external reader open-world hints, retained local validator semantics and the historical compatibility fixture, and bounded the permitted discovery migration.

limits: The repaired release is deployed and native scan clearance is reported; reviewer-case execution and public availability remain separate.
Annotation hints do not enforce authorisation or make returned content trusted.

procedures.name: Verify a public owner connection and repair minimal-input handoff semantics
procedures.trigger: A public plugin needs a real basic tool test or schema-valid output contains optional-input filler.

evidence.summary: The public One Click listing connected and generated a synthetic brief; output explicitly indicated no project creation or deployment.
Preserved regressions for omitted and explicitly empty services and repaired the numeric-filler condition.

limits: Owner-account basic success does not establish clean-account acceptance or downstream project deployment.
The candidate repair is not yet deployed.
Listing and output-schema versions remain distinct.

procedures.name: Keep website consent, operational tool telemetry and social activity separate
procedures.trigger: Launch reports infer plugin adoption from website events, tool aggregates or native scheduling.

evidence.summary: Reviewed product/property corrections, consented website events, controlled tests and operational aggregates with explicit plane and attribution limits.
Reconciled telemetry recipients, storage retention, cache duration and direct-client opt-out scope.
The same draft's refreshed metadata check now clears the privacy finding after the reviewed runtime and policy release.

limits: Policy edits alone do not clear a finding; this later checkpoint records actual native clearance.
Intermediary propagation of browser opt-out signals is unestablished.
Traffic aggregates include owner/test activity and do not prove installs or people counts.

procedures.name: Repair operational analytics at the actual API and outcome boundary
procedures.trigger: A helper uses the wrong SQL envelope or treats HTTP success as tool success.

evidence.summary: Repaired raw SQL submission and result parsing, applied explicit legacy sample weights and kept HTTP outcomes separate from MCP tool outcomes.
Confirmed that the legacy Analytics Engine API and newer Analytics SQL API have different weighting contracts.

limits: Do not apply legacy manual weights to an API that already weights supported aggregates.
Historical missing cause and test fields cannot be reconstructed.
A near-time success is not correlated attribution without linking evidence.

procedures.name: Reconcile native scheduled posts with a deterministic campaign ledger
procedures.trigger: A long campaign needs continuation without treating accepted posts as full completion.

evidence.summary: Native scheduling and readback were tracked against campaign slots and remaining work; provider limits and an inactive refill schedule remained explicit.

limits: The campaign remains incomplete; old queue totals are dated observations.
No fresh queue count or scheduling mutation was performed by this extraction.
A scheduled post is not a published result or a working product integration.

procedures.name: Correct launch copy to the highest evidenced product capability
procedures.trigger: Marketing copy equates published skills, discovery or synthetic tests with customer-ready tools.

evidence.summary: Separated published skill capability from tool connection and basic owner-test evidence, retaining activation and independent-acceptance gaps.

limits: A corrected claim is not evidence of customer adoption.
A procedure mapping does not establish that this shop prompt was loaded or invoked.

procedures.name: Link an owned capability to an independent provider without transferring commercial authority
procedures.trigger: Agent discovery needs a real service path while the shop remains a source-backed catalogue.

evidence.summary: Preserved canonical product authority, linked the exact subcontracting capability to a distinct external guide/catalogue, and recorded deployment and machine-surface acceptance on the reviewed source.

limits: A discovery link does not transfer pricing, job acceptance, payment, execution or repository authority to Agent Shop.
The newer provider job ledger requires its own exact release/readback.
Crawlable links and accepted discovery do not prove indexing, adoption or revenue.

procedures.name: Release an eligible maintenance patch under a recorded owner exception without inventing independent review
procedures.trigger: A sole maintainer cannot obtain non-author review and explicitly authorises the documented bounded release route.

evidence.summary: Recorded the owner direction and narrow eligibility, preserved technical review and all exact-head checks, and excluded self-approval, target mutation and wider authority.
Normal exact-head merge, exact-main deployment, production smoke and preserved configuration were read back; subsequent native scans cleared their findings.

limits: This is owner-directed release acceptance, not independent human review or a formal security scan.
A missing reviewer does not automatically permit an exception.
Ineligible authority-expanding changes retain their normal review gate.
Deployment and scanner success do not establish provider publication or customer outcomes.

procedures.name: Reconcile problems, attempts and evidence-qualified institutional memory
procedures.trigger: Continuation requires multi-week history with duplicate summaries, contradictions and incomplete retrieval.

evidence.summary: Parsed the complete indexed checkpoint, preserved distinct problem/attempt/source concepts and its explicit requalification of unsupported inherited success labels.
Compared selected dated records and newer public state without claiming all account chats were accessible.

limits: Source references in an index do not establish direct retrieval of all original conversations.
Historical instructions do not authorise new operational actions.

procedures.name: Recover proven stale capacity and coalesce equivalent live attempts
procedures.trigger: Durable graph capacity disagrees with attempt/lease truth or periodic monitor jobs overlap.

evidence.summary: Targeted stale effect-free recovery preserved event/checkpoint history and unrelated rows.
Live-equivalence admission followed exact ingress idempotency and did not suppress expired, failed or different-lane work.

limits: Effect-ambiguous work cannot be terminalised or retried from lease expiry alone.
Historical natural-cycle acceptance is not current runtime acceptance.

procedures.name: Require verified exact predecessors and comparable baseline measurements
procedures.trigger: A learning challenger has publication identity but lacks comparable measurement.

evidence.summary: Compared verified-equivalence and later measurement-gate rules, immutable sidecars, missing/exposure semantics and actual publication-without-measurement deferrals.

limits: Publication verification does not establish a measured baseline.
Backlog ceilings are safety bounds, not targets; unavailable zero is not zero performance.

procedures.name: Generate operating reference and examples from executable semantic contracts
procedures.trigger: Dashboard, CLI and documentation disagree about warnings, field meaning or recovery ownership.

evidence.summary: Canonical warnings, field dictionary, generated reference/examples and bounded shared snapshot projections provide a consistent operator contract.

limits: Documentation does not execute repairs or grant authority.
Dashboard caches cannot authorise consequence paths; fixture console performance does not establish publishing throughput.

procedures.name: Recover durable outcome evidence without repeating customer fulfilment
procedures.trigger: Fulfilment succeeds but evidence fails, or an outcome arrives before verified publication evidence.

evidence.summary: Checked privacy-bounded validation, holding/cursor ordering, conflict-aware ingestion and bounded fair recovery.
Reconciled earlier lost-evidence and unsigned-label findings with current duplicate-payment reconciliation and signed attribution handling.

limits: Complete contact-outbox durability and production failure-injection acceptance remain unproved.
Connected empty evidence is not zero activity; authenticated payment is not campaign authentication or causal attribution.

procedures.name: Fence registry and credential writes before erasing indexed account state
procedures.trigger: Already admitted work could restore data after deletion.

evidence.summary: Separated real account cleanup/session rejection from the synthetic admit-pause-delete-resume race and fresh registry/vault absence checks.

limits: Session invalidation alone does not prove rejection of admitted work.
Service deletion, external revocation, fixture acceptance and independent verification are distinct.

procedures.name: Repair server and first-client provider snapshot divergence
procedures.trigger: Mobile, theme or provider initialization produces hydration errors.

evidence.summary: Recovered the ineffective frame-delay workaround and matching initial state with document-level preference application outside the verified root.

limits: Arbitrary delays or warning suppression are not correctness guarantees.
The DOM ownership boundary is application-specific and other provider mismatches need separate acceptance.

procedures.name: Require App capability and identity-bound customer writer authority
procedures.trigger: Installation metadata is being used as the customer's repository authority.

evidence.summary: Current admission reads the authenticated actor's collaborator base permission independently of App grants; latest state records merged/deployed tests with a read-only actor still gated.

limits: Installation capability and repository selection do not grant customer write authority.
Merge/deployment is not a completed fresh customer journey; unknown, mismatched and API-error evidence fails closed.

procedures.name: Create and submit a walkthrough with explicit local-runtime evidence limits
procedures.trigger: A provider draft requires recorded evidence without claiming unsupported conversational or production acceptance.

evidence.summary: Recorded actual exact-release public GET server calls and boundary assertions, labelled ephemeral test signing, and verified the hosted recording's bytes.

limits: A local walkthrough is not live ChatGPT routing/refusal or production endpoint/signer acceptance.
Static route coverage remained partial; a real video does not make the evidence graph complete.

procedures.name: Reconcile byte-bound package changes and settled provider submission state
procedures.trigger: An upload or submission result conflicts with a stale list view.

evidence.summary: Added only recording metadata to the same package, preserved archive identity evidence, submitted once under current owner declarations and inspected settled detail before considering any retry.

limits: Historical owner declarations are not fresh permission to submit another draft.
In review is neither approval nor publication; stale-list retry can duplicate a consequence.
